project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: GUID of the project the node belongs to.

workflow_id.title: Workflow Id
workflow_id.description: GUID of the workflow the node belongs to.

state.title: State
state.description: Current runtime state of the node (e.g. STOPPED, STARTING, RUNNING, STOPPING, ERRORED).

messages_in.title: Messages In
messages_in.description: Count of messages received by the node since it started.

messages_out.title: Messages Out
messages_out.description: Count of messages sent by the node since it started.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Last error message reported by the runtime for this node, if any.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Kafka topics this node is currently consuming from or producing to.

materialized_commit.title: Materialized Commit
materialized_commit.description: Full hash of the commit this node's files were materialized from at its last start, resolved even when running unpinned. Empty if the node has never started. Unlike the run_commit pin, this doesn't move when new commits land - it's what the running process is actually executing.
